'''Advanced Recon Force troopers''', or simply '''ARF troopers''', were specialized [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that carried out short-range reconnaissance for [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commanders]].

==Overview==
These clone troopers were often tasked with scouting out the enemy position on the battlefield. Although stealthy and well-trained, recon troopers' duties differed from that of [[Clone commando/Legends|Clone Commandos]] or [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advance Recon Commandos]] as their focus was on gathering information about the enemy or carrying out surprise attacks. Much like the [[AT-RT driver]]s, ARF troopers would serve in that capacity.

==Equipment==
[[File:ARFcamo-TCW.png|thumb|left|180px|An ARF trooper in camouflage armor]]
In terms of equipment, ARF troopers were often provided with standard issue [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] blaster carbines, [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blasters]] as well as [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They also wore lightweight recon armor made of [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] material and surveillance gear. The belt contained spare ammunition and a medical syringe. On their left arm they had a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Life-form scanner/Legends|life-form scanner]]. Their helmet had an [[infrared]] camera so that they could operate in dark places as well as recognizing friends or foes. They often carried a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] with some basic items, such as survival rations, C.S.E.L. ([[Combat Survivor Evader Locator]]) and [[Explosive charge/Legends|explosives]], but it was possible to have [[Rope/Legends|rope]], [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], an [[Ice pick/Legends|ice pick]] and a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="SW:TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Some ARF troopers were equipped with [[Jetpack/Legends|jet packs]].<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>

In addition, they often rode [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] which could be a dangerous assignment as these [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] required their operator to show dexterity as well as considerable skill. This was largely due to the fact that they were exposed to enemy fire while they conducted their missions. These vehicles meant that ARF troopers often considered themselves a breed apart from other clone troopers as they believed riding an AT-RT was more akin to riding on a living animal than driving a vehicle. Their training often started with riding living mounts before they were allowed to operate an AT-RT [[Walker/Legends|walker]].<ref name="SW:TCWCE" /> On reconnaissance missions, ARF troopers were known to utilize [[Republic scout speeder]]s, as they provided the user with a compact, lightweight vehicle with heavy firepower. The speeder also had room to carry two troopers, which was useful for two-man operations.<ref name="CW Toy">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Republic Scout Speeder with ARF trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Republic_Scout_Speeder.asp}}</ref>

==History==
The ARF troopers are extremely adaptable and can work with just about any environment. Advanced Recon Force troopers were first introduced during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and like most of their clone brethren; they were created on the planet [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] which served as their ''"home world"'' and swore their allegiance to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SW:TCWCE" /> They proved to be valuable assets to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] due to their ability to carry out reconnaissance and deliver accurate, eye-witness reports of enemy activities, without alerting them to their presence.

<div style="float:right">[[File:ARFtroopers_report.png|thumb|200px|Two camouflaged ARF troopers report to [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Skywalker]] prior to the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]]]]</div>
During the clone wars, a pair of ARF troopers were deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] before the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] arrived to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] son.

ARF troopers were also deployed during the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to scout out the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|Twi'lek freedom fighters]] and infiltrate the capital city of [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]]. They were used in a more aggressive capacity, driving [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|AT-RTs]] to attack the [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]] that were firing at the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] walkers, and later were in the charge to retake Lessu.

A number of them later participated in the brutal battles that involved the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|retaking]] of the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] under the command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Clone Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]].

[[File:ARFScoutTrooper-DarknessOnUmbara.png|thumb|left|200px|An ARF trooper rides an AT-RT]]
A large squadron of Advanced Recon Force troopers led by Clone Commander [[Trauma/Legends|Trauma]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Halsey/Legends|Halsey]] were seen [[Devaron massacre/Legends|fighting]] at the [[Temple of Eedit/Legends|Temple of Eedit]] on the planet [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. They managed to destroy all of the droids, but they were all killed by a Nightbrother named [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].

Under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], a large force of Advance Recon Force troopers participated in the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] driving AT-RTs and played a key role in taking out an Umbaran-occupied ridge defended by tanks and [[Umbaran militia]]. The Advanced Recon Force took heavy casualties throughout the battle as they were easy targets for the Umbaran militia.

[[Hound/Legends|Hound]] was an ARF trooper who served as a sergeant within the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]], in which capacity he worked with a [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] named [[Grizzer (massiff)/Legends|Grizzer]]. Hound and Grizzer were both involved in the hunt for [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was wrongly accused of murder.<ref name="The Jedi Who Knew Too Much">{{TCW|The Jedi Who Knew Too Much}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Lost Legion|''The Lost Legion'']], the ARF trooper [[Falco (clone trooper)|Falco]] is incorrectly introduced as an Advanced Recon Fighter. Lego made three different minifigures for the ARF troopers. One was a basic ARF trooper who can be identified from the markings on his armor as a member of [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]] another was from the [[Rancor Battalion/Legends|Rancor Battalion]] and had red markings on its armor and helmet. The final minifigure was a promotional [[Shadow ARF Trooper]] whose armor is black.
